codeFixes.description: Compute true clamped segment Euclidean distance for asphalt edge/off classification so points past dead-end tips are not misclassified as asphalt; allow overlap height blending across non-plane junctions.

Clamp terrain vertices near roads below q.y - 0.40 m; remove q.junc < 0 guard on asphalt vertices; sink kerb/pavement/verge vertices overlapping another street or 3+ junction; add plain-asphalt cap discs at sharp 2-edge bends.
Check surface rays at 0..16 m ahead every 0.4 s, detect dirt cliff overhangs, track full session driven coordinates for map plotting, and capture screenshots within view.
Fix hotspot patrol capping, add --max-issues stop threshold, wait per-frame for clean screenshot capture, and export driven session path to plotFindings.
Always render map.png in dark mode with grey road network routes and light-blue session driven routes.

Remove 73 degenerate/micro-edges, repair all directed one-way traps/sinks/sources for 100% hub connectivity, smooth kinks & steep grades, trim overlapping dual carriageways, rebuild side.bin clearances, and carve ground.bin below road & junction heights.
